package.title: 100 Ordering and Scheduling Reasoning MCQs for NTS-Style Aptitude Practice

questions.question: A, B, C, and D stand in a line. A is before C, B is before C, and C is before D. Who must be last?
Five files P, Q, R, S, and T are arranged in order. P is before Q, Q before R, R before S, and S before T. Which file must be first?
Five speakers L, J, K, H, and M speak one at a time. L speaks before J, J before K, K before H, and H before M. Who speaks last?
Six books are placed left to right. E is before A, A before B, B before C, C before D, and D before F. Which book is immediately after C?
Four runners finish a race with no tie. Sana finishes ahead of Bilal, and Bilal finishes ahead of Noor. Which statement must be true?
choices: Noor finishes between Sana and Bilal

questions.question: In a queue, Omar is ahead of Zara, and Zara is ahead of Hamza. Who is behind Zara?
Four tasks W, X, Y, and Z must be completed in an order. X must occur before Z, and W must occur after Z. Which task must be before W?
A, B, C, and D are arranged from earliest to latest. C is earlier than A, and A is earlier than D. Which item cannot be earliest?
Four people enter a room one by one. R enters before S, and T enters after S. Which ordering is required among these three?
Five parcels are loaded in sequence. K is loaded before L, M after L, and N after M. Which parcel is definitely later than K?
A, B, C, and D are in a row. B is somewhere before D, while A is before B and C is after D. Which person is last?
Four machines finish a test at different times. Machine M finishes before N; N finishes before P; and Q finishes after P. Which machine finishes second?
Five lessons are arranged from first to last. History is before Science; Science is before Art; and Art is before Music. Which lesson is later than Science but earlier than Music?
Four applicants are interviewed in a line. F is interviewed after G but before H. J is interviewed before G. Who must be interviewed first?
A, B, C, and D are ordered from lightest to heaviest. A is heavier than B, C is heavier than A, and D is heavier than C. Which is heaviest?
In a queue, U stands somewhere before V, and V stands before W. Which person must not be ahead of U?
Five paintings are hung left to right. The blue painting is before the red one; the red one is before the gold one; and the white one is after the gold one. Which color must be after red?
Four jobs are done one after another. Job B is after A. Job C is after B. Job D is before A. Which job is second?
P, Q, R, and S are ordered. P is before Q, and R is after Q. S is before P. Which item is necessarily before R?
Four cyclists cross a finish line at different times. T crosses after U but before V. W crosses after V. Who crosses third?
Five letters are arranged in a sequence. A comes before C, C before E, and B after E. Which statement must be true?
Four people are ranked from oldest to youngest. R is older than S, and S is older than T. Which person is younger than R?
Four trains depart at different times. Train A leaves before B. Train C leaves after B, and D leaves after C. Which train departs latest?
Five candidates are called in order. K is called before L; M is called after L; and N is called before K. Which candidate is definitely before M?
Four boxes are arranged from left to right. Box A is left of B, and C is right of B. D is right of C. Which box is farthest right?
A team presents four reports. Report X is presented before Y. Z is presented after Y but before W. Which report is presented immediately before W if all four reports are the only presentations?
Five students are lined up. Mina is ahead of Ali; Ali is ahead of Rehan; and Rehan is ahead of Iqra. Which student is behind Ali but ahead of Iqra?
Four events occur in sequence. Event P is not first; Q occurs before P; R occurs after P; and S occurs after R. Which event must be last?
A, B, C, D, and E are arranged in a row. A is before B, B before C, and D before E. Which relation is guaranteed?
In a race of six runners, H finishes ahead of J, J ahead of K, and K ahead of L. Which runner is definitely behind H?
Four packages are processed. A is processed before B. C is processed before A. D is processed after B. Which package is second?
Five books are stacked from bottom to top. The atlas is below the dictionary, and the dictionary is below the guidebook. Which book is above the atlas?
Four people rank in a contest from first to fourth. Dani ranks ahead of Farah; Farah ranks ahead of Gohar; and Hina ranks behind Gohar. Who is fourth?
Five tasks are completed in order. Task R is before S; T is after S; U is before R; and V is after T. Which task is earliest?
Four runners finish in order. P finishes ahead of Q. R finishes between Q and S. What is the required order of Q, R, and S?
A delivery route visits four towns. A is visited before B, C after B, and D before A. Which town is visited immediately before B if these are the only four towns?
Four contestants are ranked from highest score to lowest. K scores more than L, and L more than M. N scores less than M. Who must score higher than N?
A queue has five people. A is ahead of B; C is behind B; D is ahead of A; E is behind C. Who is at the back?
Four meetings are ordered by start time. Meeting R starts before S, S before T, and Q after T. Which meeting starts first?
Five objects are sorted from shortest to tallest. P is taller than Q; R is taller than P; S is shorter than Q; and T is taller than R. Which object is shortest?
In a line of four people, A stands somewhere before B, and C stands after B. D stands before A. Who is immediately before B?
Five stages are completed in order. Stage 2 follows Stage 1; Stage 3 follows Stage 2; Stage 4 follows Stage 3; Stage 5 follows Stage 4. Which stage is third?
Four students submit assignments at different times. A submits before B, C submits after B, and D submits before A. Who submits just before C if these are the only students?
Six runners finish a race. T is ahead of U, U ahead of V, and V ahead of W. Which runner is necessarily not among these four runners' earliest finisher?
Four items are ordered by weight. A weighs more than B; C weighs less than B; and D weighs more than A. Which item is second heaviest?
In a queue, X is behind Y, Z is ahead of Y, and W is behind X. Which person must be ahead of X?
A, B, C, and D complete a relay in that order subject to these clues: C is after A, B is after C, and D is after B. Who runs second?
A five-person panel speaks one at a time. J speaks before K, L speaks after K, M speaks before J, and N speaks after L. Who is last?
On a Monday-to-Friday workweek, a report is reviewed on Wednesday. A second report is reviewed the next day. On which day is the second report reviewed?
A meeting is scheduled two days after Monday. On which day does it occur?
A workshop occurs on Friday. A briefing takes place one weekday before it. When is the briefing?
A test is held on Tuesday. A review session is held three days later, counting Wednesday as one day later. What day is the review?
A training session must occur on a weekday after Wednesday but before Friday. Which day is possible?
A delivery arrives on Thursday. The order was dispatched one weekday earlier. On which day was it dispatched?
A team meets on Monday and again exactly four days later. What is the second meeting day?
An interview is held on Wednesday. A written test is scheduled two weekdays before it. When is the written test?
A seminar is held on Tuesday. A follow-up is held on the next weekday. When is the follow-up?
A report is due on Friday. A draft must be submitted two weekdays earlier. What is the draft deadline?
A class occurs on Thursday, and a quiz occurs the weekday immediately before the class. When is the quiz?
A project starts on Monday and lasts three consecutive weekdays, with Monday counted as day one. On what day does it end?
A library event is held on Friday. A planning meeting takes place two weekdays before it. When is the planning meeting?
A field visit is on Thursday. A preparation session occurs three days earlier, counting calendar days and allowing the weekend. What day is the preparation session?
A task is scheduled for Wednesday. A second task occurs the weekday after the first, and a third occurs the weekday after the second. What day is the third task?
An exam is scheduled for Monday. A practice session is held five calendar days earlier. What day is the practice session?
A meeting is on Friday. A reminder is sent two calendar days before it. What day is the reminder sent?
A workshop is on Tuesday. A planning meeting is held the weekday before the workshop. What day is the planning meeting?
A review is held on Thursday. A follow-up is held four weekdays later, with Friday as the first day later. What day is the follow-up?
A team works Monday through Friday. If a task begins on Thursday and takes two consecutive weekdays including the start day, when is it finished?
An appointment falls on Wednesday. A reminder is sent the previous calendar day. When is the reminder sent?
A test takes place on Thursday. A candidate's preparation begins exactly one week earlier. On which day does preparation begin?
A lecture is held on Monday. A discussion is held two weekdays afterward. What day is the discussion?
A report is presented on Tuesday. Another report is presented on the weekday immediately following it. When is the second report presented?
A deadline is on Friday. Work must be completed three weekdays before the deadline. What is the completion day?
A session takes place on Wednesday. A related session takes place the following Monday. How many calendar days separate the sessions?
A test is on Monday. A practice test is on the preceding Friday. How many calendar days before the test is the practice test?
Tasks A, B, and C must be completed in order, with each task beginning immediately after the previous one. If A takes one hour and B takes two hours, when does C begin after A starts at 9:00 a.m.?
A recipe requires mixing before baking, and cooling after baking. Which step must be last among these three?
A printer setup requires loading paper before printing and printing before binding. Which step must occur first?
Four steps are arranged: inspect before repair, repair before testing, and testing before packing. Which step is immediately before packing if these are the only four steps?
A document must be drafted before editing; editing must occur before approval. Which statement is necessarily true?
A computer is switched on before a program is opened. The program is opened before a file is saved. What must happen before the file is saved?
choices: Switching on and opening the program

questions.question: A lab procedure requires measuring a sample, then adding a reagent, then recording the result. What happens immediately before recording?
Four steps A, B, C, and D satisfy A before C, B before C, and C before D. Which step is definitely last?
A package must be sealed after the item is placed inside, and labelled after it is sealed. What must happen first?
A job has three steps: A precedes B, and C precedes B. No relationship between A and C is specified. Which conclusion is valid?
choices: Both A and C precede B

questions.question: A system is tested only after installation, and approval occurs only after the test. Which order is required?
A meeting agenda has opening remarks before the report, and the report before questions. Which item comes immediately before questions if these are the only agenda items?
A phone is unlocked before an application is opened. A message is sent after the application is opened. Which action must occur before sending the message?
choices: Unlocking the phone and opening the application

questions.question: Four processes P, Q, R, and S obey P before Q, R before Q, and Q before S. Which process must be last?
A safety check occurs before machine operation. Cleaning occurs after operation. Which event must occur between the check and cleaning?
A recipe's four stages satisfy chopping before cooking, cooking before serving, and washing after serving. Which stage is last?
A, B, and C are steps in a process. B must follow A, but C may occur at any time. Which statement is guaranteed?
choices: C is between A and B

questions.question: A form is completed before it is submitted. Submission occurs before confirmation is received. What happens first?
A package is weighed before postage is calculated. A label is printed after postage is calculated. Which step is necessarily between weighing and label printing?
Tasks L, M, N, and O are sequenced so that L precedes N, N precedes M, and M precedes O. What is immediately before O?
An event registration requires choosing a session before paying, and payment before receiving a ticket. What must occur before payment?
choices: Both choosing and receiving a ticket

questions.question: A pilot study is completed before a full study, and the full study is completed before analysis. Which task cannot be first?
choices: Either pilot study or full study

questions.question: Four boxes are packed in order. Box A is packed before B; C is packed after B; D is packed before A. Which box is packed second?
In a five-person race, K finishes ahead of L; M finishes behind L; N finishes ahead of K; and P finishes behind M. Who finishes last?
Five workshops A, B, C, D, and E run one per weekday from Monday to Friday. A is Monday, B is before C, D is after C, and E is Friday. Which workshop must be Tuesday?
